title: t4 (seed-1): no behaviour to explain - dataset answers do not match the model's outputs
label: null result - behaviour absent, nothing verified
behavior: BOS + 6 tokens over 5 symbols -> one symbol at the last position, as labelled by dataset task 'bench' (benchmarks/glassbox-bench/seed-1/tasks/t4).
summary: The investigation stopped at the baseline. On 200 inputs at full precision (local-full) the model's top token equals the dataset's answer only 17% of the time, against 20% chance for five symbols; the mean logit difference is -0.025. The pre-registered prediction (accuracy >= 0.95) was refuted. The model does emit a crisp output (per-prompt logit differences are exactly -1, 0 or +1), but that output is unrelated to the dataset labels, so the labelled behaviour does not exist in this model. No function, circuit or predict() is claimed and no verification was run.

claims.text: The model does not produce the dataset's answers: accuracy 0.17 on n=200 (chance 0.20), mean logit diff -0.025, full precision local-full. Pre-registered prediction of >= 0.95 accuracy refuted.

The model's output is nonetheless crisp: every per-prompt logit difference between the labelled answer and the foil is exactly -1, 0 or +1, so the mismatch is in the labels' relation to the model, not in a noisy model.
